reasoning: A cricket academy requires an energetic, professional, and trustworthy environment. Using the Performance Pro archetype in a dark theme captures the 'stadium under floodlights' aesthetic, providing a high-impact, focused, and sporty feel without falling into generic tech/SaaS traps. The color palette draws from real-world cricket elements: deep stadium night shadows, leather ball crimson, and outfield green.

typography.heading_strategy: Uppercase or tight-tracked athletic sans for high impact. Use font-black (900) for hero headings and font-bold (700) for section headings.
typography.body_strategy: Clean, highly readable geometric sans for data clarity and forms.

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 for cards to let content breathe. Avoid cramped data views.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_pages: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetric bento grids for features. Overlapping images. Use high contrast sections with generous padding (py-24).
layout_and_spacing.dashboards: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. Strict grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. 1px borders, flat backgrounds. No floating soft cards.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_surfaces: Use 1px solid borders (border-border) with flat colors. Replace soft drop-shadows with inner glows or sharp neon 1px strokes for active states. Use 'The Tracing Beam' or neon highlight for primary calls to action.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). High contrast text. Hover state must brighten the background and keep text readable.
components.cards: Cardless or flat geometric panels (rounded-md max). Border border-white/10. No massive drop shadows; use solid backgrounds.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav. Use 'Crystal Glass' effect (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border).
components.tables_and_lists: Dense data view for admin. Generous row padding for player stats. Alternating row colors or simple thin bottom borders.
components.forms: Use Shadcn forms. Inputs should have muted dark backgrounds with a bright primary ring on focus.

animations.interactions: Snappy, not floaty. Fast transitions (duration-150) for hover states.
animations.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid elements.
animations.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with border color shifting to primary or secondary depending on context.

hero_background.description: Packed stadium during a thrilling night cricket match under floodlights. Use with bg-black/60 overlay to ensure text contrast.

hero_action.description: Dynamic cricket match scene with batsman in action.

about_coach.description: Professional looking coach. Use for About Us or Coach Profiles.

cricket_ball_detail.description: Macro shot of red leather cricket ball. Great for feature card backgrounds.

game_ground.description: Ground view for weekly games location card.

key_screens.name: Landing Page
sections: Hero: Massive Barlow Condensed H1, Stadium Background (heavy overlay), dual CTA (Book Lane, Join Academy).
Marquee: Scrolling text of 'TRAIN LIKE A PRO • HIGH PERFORMANCE • ELITE COACHING'.
Features Bento Grid: Highlighting Lane Booking, 1-1 Coaching, Match Analysis.
About Us: Coach profiles in stark, high-contrast cards.

key_screens.name: User Dashboard
sections: Upcoming Schedule: Horizontal scroll or tight grid of next booked lane and coaching session.
Kids Progress: Line charts (Recharts) showing batting/bowling improvement over time.
Weekly Match: Detailed card with map placeholder, team roster, and WhatsApp join link.

key_screens.name: Booking Module
sections: Calendar View: Shadcn calendar styled with dark theme.
Time Slots: Selectable chips for available times.
Confirmation: Modal with details and policy (modify up to 24 hrs).

key_screens.name: Admin Dashboard
sections: Overview: KPI metrics (Active lanes, pending sessions, kids enrolled).
User Management: Table view of users/coaches with roles.
Progress Reporting: Form to input weekly stats and generate email/in-app notifications.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on the #D82234 primary button meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-lane-button').
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Focus states must use ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup the required fonts (Barlow Condensed, DM Sans) via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Customize Tailwind config with the provided color hexes in the exact structure above.
Do NOT use pure border-radius on everything; mix sharp edges and slight rounding (rounded-sm/md) to maintain an athletic aesthetic.
Implement Lucide-react for standard UI icons and consider Phosphor Icons for bolder sports imagery if needed.
Build the dashboard using a 'Control Room' grid philosophy - dense, 1px borders, data-heavy but clean.
Do NOT use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the exact URLs provided in the media section.
For progress charts, use Recharts and theme the strokes with the primary (#D82234) and secondary (#10B981) colors.
